description: spike_beak_3 default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture baked onto the low (improved/textures/spike_beak_3_basecolor.png) with the finish's recolours (mask / beak / legs to the beak chip, the white stomach wrapped further back, white tail tips, the orange head blobs to blue / mask yellow); proxy_albedo (white) tints it.
